task: T4 — bilateral TextTiling-style signal in stream detector
hypothesis: EMA-depth (T1b) didn't separate bge-m3 on T3 calibration (95 pairs, boundary median=-0.063 vs same-topic=-0.075). Bilateral cosine-distance is non-adaptive and may separate. We add it as a SECOND telemetry signal alongside EMA, and as a complementary threshold when EMA is noisy.

changes.what: Added getters: bilateralWindow (default 2), rollingBufferSize (20), dispersionMultiplier (1.6), bilateralFloor (0.12).
Added static helpers mean(List<float[]>) and bilateralGap(List<float[]>, int at, int window) (returns 1-cosine, TextTiling-style).

detectBoundary: compute bilateralGap inline over rollingBufferSize with bilateralWindow vectors on each side. Emitted in semantic_debug wire event as 'bilateral_gap' field. Decision logic UNCHANGED — EMA-depth still drives commit/candidate; bilateralGap is telemetry + available as complementary threshold (config bilateralFloor).
Added bilateralGapHelperSeparatesTopics: Text.bilateralGap boundary ~1 vs within-topic ~0.
Schema doc for semantic_debug wire event including bilateral_gap field and calibration knobs.
